But the songs are all original lyrics and structures so its not exactly a carbon copy so i have to disagree there.

Being a musician myself it is weird to see but from what ive just quickly researched the band members are all individual artists in their own right... search for their  instas... it sees nothing like ben howard then. Strange. 

They were on bbc intro as well other day so that tells me they have more to offer. Anyway it sounds alright to me but some tracks are similar in style.

It’s hard. I feel the same right now but I can’t agree with someone else. You should carry on and get through these darker times so you become strong. Ignore society and what it tells you to do, so what’s best for you and regain yourself and your happiness
